candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: All text and furigana (たから, じっさい, てつだ, けんきゅうかいはつ, せいこう) are correct. The option box is rendered as a table, but options a/b sit in the header row, which misrepresents them as headers. No space after the circled numbers; minor.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Text and furigana are fully correct. The option box is a blockquote, which suggests the box reasonably, but the two lines have no hard break and may merge when rendered. Blanks preserved.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Text and furigana are correct. Adds a '##' heading for the title, which is acceptable. The option box is plain text with no box structure, and its lines may merge when rendered. Uses full-width digits (１２月１日), a harmless variation.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Text and furigana are all correct. The option box is a clean 2x2 table with an empty header row. Uses 'a.' with a half-width period instead of the image's 'a．'; negligible.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Text and furigana are all correct. The option box is a clean 2x2 table with an empty header, and the full-width periods and blank widths match the image closely.

rationale: All five candidates transcribe the text and furigana without error and invent nothing, so the ranking rests only on how well each represents the boxed option list. E and D use a clean 2x2 table with an empty header; E edges ahead by matching the full-width punctuation and blank widths. A's table wrongly puts options a/b in the header row. B's blockquote at least marks the box, while C has no box structure at all, and both risk the two option lines merging when rendered.
